lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 4 nodes, extending posteriorly from the gill region across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical pale bands intersect with the spots, creating a grid-like pattern where spots are positioned as anchor nodes within the vertical intensity gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges run horizontally along the upper and mid-flank, characterized by highlight-to-shadow transitions from dorsal to ventral edges.
